verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export feature, with scheduled automated full exports, in open formats: properties become Markdown front matter, collections are stored as CSV, and exports are described as human- and machine-readable. Several parts of the story are only implied, so it falls short of complete coverage. missing for 10: explicit documentation of on-demand manual full export 'at any time', confirmation that media files and links/backlinks are preserved in the export, independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can export my entire knowledge base at any time in open formats, so leaving is as easy as arriving

citations.quote: You can schedule automatic exports by going to `Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule`.
All your properties are transformed into front matter values, all collections are stored as CSV files, making it easy to reuse your content in other apps or work with it programmatically.
Exports from Capacities are fully human- and machine-readable at the same time.
